headline: MIT leads NEWMAC in wins and goals
dek: MIT took 21 wins against one draw and three losses across all matches, scoring 76 goals while conceding eight. Twenty different players found the net for the program, setting a standard no other NEWMAC side matched.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring falls off sharply down the table: even Salve Regina, with 59 goals, outscored Emerson, Smith, Coast Guard, and Mount Holyoke combined.

wire.line: Mount Holyoke finished winless, with two draws and nine losses while conceding 45 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two Coast Guard matches from late August remain past their scheduled dates with no published result, accounting for all unresolved dates in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wellesley goalkeeper Olivia Lore made 138 saves while allowing 25 goals, finishing with an 0.847 save percentage and eight shutouts.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nineteen different players scored for Salve Regina across a season that ended with twelve wins, five draws, and four losses.

last_match.line: The loss snapped MIT's winning streak that stretched back to early October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
